overview: The Xi Thall Sanctum is the command heart of Akhevan leadership.
details: Priest-lords oversee void rites, temporal discipline, and resonance governance. Their authority shapes the entire Vex Thal megastructure.
hooks: A Xi Thall rite activates, drawing voidborn into the sanctum.
Temporal discipline chambers destabilize, fracturing time.
A priest-lord awakens from deep stasis.
Glyph halls resonate with ancient Akhevan commands.
